title: Iceberg
caption: A fixed waterline connects the visible tip and hidden keel
intro: Compare the whole iceberg at two scales, a keel fitted to a target depth, and the tip and keel in isolation. The dashed guide is the same waterline in every specimen. The iceberg itself never moves.
contract: Import Iceberg from slide-shared/iceberg/scenery/iceberg. x centers the drawing and waterline joins tip and keel. scale resizes both; depthScale stretches only the keel. depthScaleForKeel comes from scenery/scenery.pure. A story Scene usually lets ZoneScene choose the iceberg part.

variants.depth: Keel fitted from waterline 400 to depth 575
